description: This file provides an abstraction API for elliptic curve (EC) cryptography functions within the libwebsockets project, supporting different OpenSSL versions and optional libraries like wolfSSL. It includes functions for key generation, import, ECDH, ECDSA signing and verification, and curve management, as well as data structures defining supported curves.

methods.name: lws_genec_create
methods.description: Initialize a context for EC operations, specifying whether for ECDH or ECDSA.

methods.name: int lws_genecdh_create(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,struct lws_context * context,const struct lws_ec_curves * curve_table)
methods.description: Create an EC Diffie-Hellman (ECDH) context with a specified curve table.

methods.name: int lws_genecdsa_create(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,struct lws_context * context,const struct lws_ec_curves * curve_table)
methods.description: Create an EC Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) context with a specified curve table.

methods.name: int lws_genecdh_set_key(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,struct lws_gencrypto_keyelem * el,enum enum_lws_dh_side side)
methods.description: Set the EC key for the ECDH operation side using provided key elements.

methods.name: int lws_genecdsa_set_key(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,const struct lws_gencrypto_keyelem * el)
methods.description: Set the EC key for the ECDSA operation.

methods.name: int lws_genecdsa_hash_sign_jws(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,enum lws_genhash_types hash_type,int keybits,uint8_t * sig,size_t sig_len)
methods.description: Sign data using ECDSA and produce a JWS-compatible signature.

methods.name: int lws_genecdsa_hash_sig_verify_jws(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,const uint8_t * in,enum lws_genhash_types hash_type,int keybits,const uint8_t * sig,size_t sig_len)
methods.description: Verify an ECDSA signature against data in JWS format.

methods.name: int lws_genecdh_compute_shared_secret(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,uint8_t * ss,int * ss_len)
methods.description: Compute the ECDH shared secret given local and remote keys.

methods.name: int lws_genec_new_keypair(struct lws_genec_ctx * ctx,enum enum_lws_dh_side side,const char * curve_name,struct lws_gencrypto_keyelem * el)
methods.description: Generate a new EC keypair for a specified curve and store the components in key elements.
